served.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-21 ('ship it all ... grow every single week'). Overrides the preregistered rule, which v2 did not clear against v1-as-trained on 2025 holdout log loss (0.6390 vs 0.6362, CI spans zero); v2 beats v1 as trained on the full 2011-2025 backtest (MAE -0.135, log loss -0.0094) and v1 as shipped everywhere.

contract: Per game: fair_home_margin (+ = home), fair_home_line (book convention), home_win_prob, tie_prob, fair moneylines, range80 (centred on the margin), components that sum exactly to fair_home_margin, the starter priced, qb_scenarios for a contested starter, disagreement vs the reference line. distribution (sigma + key-number multipliers by |margin|) prices any spread: P(M=k) proportional to exp(-((k-mu')/sigma)^2/2) * mult[|k|], mu' solved so the mean is the margin.
